business_problem: create a single, event-based data ecosystem that could bridge lines of business, integrate core SaaS systems, and support operational reporting plus ML at CityFibre’s pace of growth.
solution_summary: CityFibre uses Snowflake, Snowpark, and SageMaker on Snowflake to create a single, event-based data ecosystem that could bridge lines of business, integrate core SaaS systems, and support operational reporting plus ML at CityFibre’s pace of growth. Network planning, order-management, and compliance data are centralized in Snowflake so operations and data teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Snowpark keeps transformation and application logic close to the governed data instead of forcing the team to move workloads into separate compute environments. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. CityFibre moved from one line of business using the platform to eight in 18 months while building the event-based architecture it needed for operational efficiency and future growth.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Snowpark
solution_components.role: Runs transformations, analytics, and application logic directly where Snowflake data already lives.

solution_components.name: SageMaker
solution_components.role: Runs machine learning training or inference against data prepared in Snowflake.
